records.title: 10-K
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Mileage Plan other revenue increased $129 million, or 28%, as compared to 2021, largely due to an increase in commissions from our bank card partners driven by increased consumer spending and improved economics from our new co-branded credit card agreement.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: On a consolidated basis, Passenger revenue for 2022 increased by $3.3 billion, or 60%, on a 33% increase in passenger traffic and a 20% increase in ticket yield.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Non-fuel operating expense, excluding special items, increased 23% in 2022 over the prior year period, while capacity was up 16%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As a result of elevated fuel prices and increased consumption, total economic fuel cost incurred was $1.3 billion higher than 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Generated positive operating cash flow of $1.4 billion, bolstered by improved advance bookings in a historic demand environment as well as our co-branded credit card agreement with Bank of America.
